historicalF3.reason: The frozen 16-action F3 budget contained zero factual accepted=true/completed=false actions. A new prospective protocol cannot retroactively change that failure.

evidenceSeparation.rule: Synthetic fault evidence must be stored under syntheticTrials, must never appear in physical records, and cannot satisfy freshness, control, pose, basin, readiness, split, training, STOP or model-evaluation counts.

requirements: Every physical record declares evidenceDomain=REAL_UNITY_PHYSICAL, synthetic=false and faultInjected=false.
Every retained accepted and discarded capture uses the direct producer path with zero active aggregators.

Every accepted capture has producerPoseEpoch=poseEpoch, producerUnityFrame>poseAppliedUnityFrame, producerSamplesPublished=1, a strictly increasing producerScanSerial and a matching acquisition order.
Accepted scientific image hashes are unique; discarded warmups remain indexed but cannot satisfy any gate.
All accepted controls are T7/contact/workspace/evaluator positive at the frozen score floor.
Rejected and rollback are derived from actual flags; rollback must restore the recorded pre-action pose within frozen tolerances.
No deterministic fault-injection record may be counted as a real physical incomplete action.
issuedDelta is nonzero and actualDelta differs from issuedDelta
odometryDeltaApplied equals actualDelta, not the full issuedDelta
postVisitedCellIds equals preVisitedCellIds and the planned full-move target cell is absent
best-memory identity and canonical checksum are unchanged
returnAnchorSource=last_confirmed_actual_pose and no safe-return calculation assumes full issued motion
the final causal history entry records issued action, actual executed action/delta, accepted=true and completed=false after actuator feedback
offline and live transition semantics are canonically identical

sealRequirements: all indexed files match declared size and SHA-256
manifest, report and evidence-index hashes match the seal
scene, evaluator, source commit, manifest and audit protocol identities match the prefrozen contract

prospectiveSignals.REAL_IMAGE_POSE_FRESHNESS: PASS only from immutable REAL_UNITY_PHYSICAL captures satisfying the producer-pose and repeat/transition gates.
prospectiveSignals.REAL_ACTION_FEEDBACK_INTEGRITY: PASS only from real actuator feedback for lateral, longitudinal, rotation, rejected, rollback and observe cases; deterministic fault injection is excluded.
prospectiveSignals.INCOMPLETE_FAULT_INJECTION: PASS only from the quarantined deterministic accepted=true/completed=false semantics tests.
prospectiveSignals.CAPTURE_PATH_INTEGRATION: PASS only when every real accepted/discarded capture proves the frozen direct-producer path and producer-pose handshake.
prospectiveSignals.FINAL_CAPTURE_ENGINEERING_PASS: True only when the four prospective real/synthetic signals above all PASS, evidence-domain separation passes, snapshot integrity passes, and HISTORICAL_F3_VERDICT remains IMAGE_POSE_FRESHNESS_FAIL.

stageB.grid: Predeclared exact anchor plus symmetric lateral, longitudinal and yaw offsets, wider scouting and frozen deterministic refinement.
stageB.passEvidence: A connected positive-cell component with a stable interior representative, repeated fresh captures and structural variation; a single isolated positive is insufficient.

stageC.entry: Allowed only after Stage B PASS.
stageC.minimumReachability: At least one new start reaches a stable acceptable T7 basin.
stageC.exclusions: Synthetic evidence and historical locked/reserved families are excluded from readiness counts.

stageD.entry: Capture only after Stage C reachability PASS; training/model evaluation only after immutable R6 data-readiness PASS.
stageD.requirements: Existing frozen R6 readiness rules, a prefrozen group/component split, causal actually-executed action history and offline/live preprocessing parity remain unchanged.

modelEvaluation.entry: Readiness GO only; group-level splits only.
modelEvaluation.checkpoint: Every Prompt 3 candidate remains BLOCKED/NON_DEPLOYABLE; quality is ranking-only and cannot authorize STOP.

livePOC.entry: Separate approval only after reachability PASS and a legitimate model-development PASS; no Stage F-Final result authorizes live STOP.

A.label: SCIENTIFICALLY_VALIDATED_FIXED_ANATOMY_SIMULATOR_POC
A.rule: Only if every required independent scientific and safety gate passes.
A.claimBoundary: Limited to the same Unity anatomy; no clinical or unseen-patient claim.

B.label: ENGINEERING_DEMO_ONLY
B.rule: A genuine image-only end-to-end simulator demo works under the limited fixed-anatomy development protocol, but independent validation is insufficient.
B.claimBoundary: Every model remains NON_DEPLOYABLE and exact supported conditions must be documented.

C.label: PHASE2_NO_GO
C.rule: Any mandatory physical, capture, recognition, return or scientific-integrity gate fails.
C.attribution: Distinguish implementation failure, insufficient data, incomplete coverage and observability hypothesis; never claim fundamental impossibility without evidence.

overallGate: PASS only when immutable snapshot integrity, the real Unity physical gate, deterministic synthetic fault-semantics gate and evidence-domain separation all pass. Missing, mutable, mixed-domain or unknown evidence fails closed.
